digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC harness, reconciler output contract
propositions: commit c87afedba8 re-pointed DC harness cells at the sync route, which suppresses OK: output per route gating at __main__.py:437, causing two test assertions to fail on a signal the invoked route never prints

the zero-write idempotence assertion cannot rely on BRIDGE_STATE: converged alone, because __main__.py classifies both converged zero-write and converged N-mutation passes with CONVERGED state, so the assertion must also require zero RECON differ totals and zero per-mutation RECON: batch_outcome lines

test helpers _assert_converged_writing_pass and _assert_wrote_nothing cite stale __main__.py line numbers that have rotted; they need replacement with references to the actual contract sources (run_differs.py, applier.py, docs/exit-codes.md)

parsing logic for canonical sync route output must move into a dependency-free test module so unit tests can exercise the predicates against synthetic captures without Jira, network, or live credentials
live DC harness cells must remain enabled and non-skipped; their green is verified only by a downstream Live External Integration run, not by unit tests alone
